description: Small safe goals on the AWOS repo itself — proves cheap-only PEI before agency outreach.

tasks.goal: In scaffold/agent/usage_record.py add a concise module-level docstring if one is missing or too short
In scaffold/agent/escalation_engine.py add a one-line docstring to is_cheap_only() explaining it returns True when premium models are halted
In scaffold/agent/budget_ledger.py add a one-line comment above get_status explaining it returns month-to-date budget status
In scaffold/agent/worker.py add a short # comment above _try_cheap_fallback explaining it tries alternate cheap providers
In scaffold/agent/run_diagnostics.py add a short # comment above print_visual_diff explaining it shows the applied patch in the terminal
In scaffold/agent/verifier.py add a one-line docstring to _check_edit_fidelity explaining it rejects edits that miss comment-above or symbol-placement goals
In scaffold/agent/usage_record.py add a short # comment above merge_result_usage explaining it merges worker API usage into a task accumulator
In scaffold/agent/run_diagnostics.py add a one-line docstring to TaskDiagnostic.record explaining it appends a stage entry to the diagnostic trace
In scaffold/agent/cheap_planner.py add a short # comment above _normalize_plan_paths explaining it fixes bare filenames to scaffold/agent paths
In scaffold/agent/integration_reviewer.py add a one-line docstring to _is_cheap_only explaining it reads AWOS_CHEAP_ONLY from the environment
In scaffold/agent/orchestrator.py add a one-line docstring to _cheap_call explaining it calls the cheap LLM tier with retries
In scaffold/agent/pei_report.py add a short module-level docstring explaining PEI uses tokens as the primary cost measure
In scaffold/agent/prompt_evolver.py add a one-line docstring to should_evolve explaining it triggers prompt evolution every N sessions
In scaffold/agent/stability_gate.py add a one-line docstring to should_check explaining it gates scaffold evolution checks by session count
In scaffold/agent/escalation_engine.py add a short # comment above max_allowed_level explaining it caps the model ladder in cheap-only mode
In scaffold/agent/runtime_session.py add a one-line docstring to RuntimeSessionStore.list_sessions explaining it returns durable sessions sorted by updated time
In scaffold/agent/learning_policy.py add a one-line docstring to apply_kernel_defaults explaining it enables runtime sessions, learning, and MCTS unless opted out
In scaffold/agent/mcts_policy.py add a one-line docstring to mcts_enabled explaining it controls whether MCTS fallback runs after worker failure
In scaffold/agent/worktree.py add a one-line docstring to register_worktree explaining it reattaches a persisted worktree path for session resume
In scaffold/agent/token_tracker.py add a one-line docstring to check_guard explaining it blocks requests when the monthly budget cap is exceeded
